audit_items.proof_trace: Single-use is enforced by two layers: (1) `is_used` boolean flag checked at L243 blocks sequential replay attempts, and (2) the DB-level `UNIQUE` constraint on `attendance.users.card_id` (migration L18) causes any concurrent different-user upsert to fail before reaching the `is_used=true` update at L267, while same-user concurrent calls are idempotent via `onConflict: 'supabase_auth_user_id'`. The property assertion references `completed_at`, which does not exist in the `temp_registrations` schema — the actual mechanism is `is_used boolean`, a naming divergence only with equivalent functional semantics.
